# `/machine-accounts` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /machine-accounts/v2/machine-account-create

`createMachineAccountV2` — Create Machine Account (v2) — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Submits a machine account creation request. New integrations should use this operation. This operation accepts the same request and runs the same creation process as [Submit Machine Account Creation Request](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/create-machine-account-request-v-2). That operation stays on the account-requests API for integrations that already call it. When version 1 cannot create the account because the subtype is not tied to a single source, the error directs the caller…

- Scopes: sp:scopes:default
- User levels: USER
- Body (application/json): machineaccountcreaterequestinputv2
- Returns 202: accountrequestasyncresult

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/{id}/enable

`enableMachineAccountV1` — Enable machine account — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API submits a task to enable a machine account and returns the task ID. A caller who owns the machine account can enable it. Other callers need the **idn:mis-account:enable** right.

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:enable
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Returns 202: machineaccountsasyncresult

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/{id}/reload

`reloadMachineAccountV1` — Reload machine account — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API asynchronously reloads the machine account directly from the connector and performs a one-time aggregation. It returns the task ID. A caller who owns the machine account can reload it. Other callers need the **idn:mis-account:reload** right.

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:reload
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Returns 202: machineaccountsasyncresult

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/{id}/remove

`deleteMachineAccountAsyncV1` — Remove machine account — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to remove a machine account from SailPoint Identity Security. The source account is left unchanged, and a removed machine account can be re-created during the next aggregation. The response returns the task ID. This endpoint is intended for: * Removing machine accounts that no longer exist on the source. * Removing machine accounts that will not be aggregated after a source configuration change. * Forcing machine accounts to be re-created on the next aggregation so account…

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:remove
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Returns 202: machineaccountsasyncresult

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/{id}/delete

`deleteMachineAccountV1` — Delete machine account — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to submit a request to delete a machine account from its source. Depending on the tenant's account deletion approval settings, the request can need approval before the account is deleted. The response returns the ID of the account request. A caller who owns the machine account can delete it. Other callers need the…

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Body (application/json): machineaccountdeleterequest
- Returns 202: machineaccountrequestasyncresult

### GET /machine-accounts/v1/{id}/machine-identities

`listMachineAccountMachineIdentitiesV1` — List linked machine identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to list the machine identities that are linked to a machine account through source resource links. The response is an empty list when no machine identities are linked. This API returns `400` when the machine account has no native identity or source. A caller who owns the machine account can list its machine identities. Other callers need the **idn:mis-account:read** right. When this capability is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `403`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Returns 200: array of machineaccountlinkedmachineidentity

### GET /machine-accounts/v1/machine-accounts-summary

`getMachineAccountsSummaryV1` — Get machine account candidate summary — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to count the machine account candidates that are not yet linked to a machine identity, grouped by the classification method that found them. Candidates that are correlated to a human identity are counted in `human`; candidates that are not correlated to any identity are counted in `uncorrelated`. This API requires the **idn:mis-account-list:read** right.

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:manage, idn:mis-account:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: source.id: eq, in — e.g. `source.id eq "8d3e0094e99445de98eef6c75e25jc04"`
- Returns 200: machineaccountssummary

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/bulk-update

`updateMachineAccountsInBulkV1` — Update machine accounts in bulk — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to apply the same [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) to up to 100 machine accounts. The response has one result per requested machine account, in no particular order. Each result has its own HTTP-style `status`: `200` when the update succeeded, `404` when the account was not found or is not accessible to the caller, `409` when the same ID appears more than once in the batch, or `400` when that row cannot be updated. Each patch operation must target one of these…

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): machineaccountbulkupdaterequest

### POST /machine-accounts/v1/bulk-enable

`enableMachineAccountsInBulkV1` — Enable machine accounts in bulk — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to submit one task that enables up to 100 machine accounts, and get the task ID. Machine accounts that are already enabled or that can't be enabled are skipped. When none of the machine accounts can be enabled, the task completes with an error. The request fails with `400` when `ids` is empty or has more than 100 entries. A caller who owns the machine accounts can enable them. Other callers need the **idn:mis-account:enable** right. For a caller without the right, machine accounts…

- Scopes: idn:mis-account-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): machineaccountbulkrequest
- Returns 202: machineaccountrequestasyncresult

### GET /machine-accounts/v2/{id}

`getMachineAccountV2` — Get machine account details — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to get the details of a machine account, including all of its linked machine identities. A caller who owns the machine account can get it. Other callers need the **idn:mis-account:read** right. When this capability is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `403`.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
- Returns 200: machineaccountv2

### PATCH /machine-accounts/v2/{id}

`updateMachineAccountV2` — Update machine account details — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to update a machine account with a [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) document. The response is the updated machine account. - Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Account ID.
